goals.description: Deploy an image classification model on a small edge device

metrics.description: Model artifact size, memory utilization, and CPU utilization stay within device limits

system.task: Classify package condition from edge-device camera images
system.usage_context: The model runs on a small warehouse intake device with limited local compute resources
risks: The model may not fit on the deployment device
The inference process may exceed available memory
The inference process may consume too much CPU during normal operation

fields.name: file name
fields.expected_values: PNG or JPG image file path

model.capability_deployment_mechanism: The model is packaged as a local artifact and called by the edge inference service

input_specification.name: file name
input_specification.expected_values: PNG or JPG image file path

system_requirements.stimulus: The trained model artifact is prepared for edge deployment
system_requirements.response: The model artifact fits within the available local storage budget
system_requirements.measure: the local model artifact size is no more than 150 MB

system_requirements.stimulus: The local inference process runs on the edge device
system_requirements.response: The local inference process stays within the available memory budget
system_requirements.measure: the maximum local process memory utilization is less than 512 MB

system_requirements.stimulus: The local inference process runs on the edge device
system_requirements.response: The local inference process stays within the available CPU budget
system_requirements.measure: the maximum local process CPU utilization is less than 75%
